svg.title: Same model, same card: Qwen3.8-27B on one Tesla V100 32 GB
svg.desc: Same model, same card: Qwen3.8-27B on one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB. Decode speed per user, tokens per second: 1 user: this port with MTP speculation 83.2, llama.cpp Q4_K_M with the checkpoint MTP head 64.6, this port with speculation off 30.9, llama.cpp Q4_K_M without speculation 33.2. 4 users at once, per user: 64.9, 31.8, 28.3 and 20.5. First token for a 30,720-token prompt: this port 35.5 s, llama.cpp Q4_K_M 49.3 s. Four such prompts at once: llama.cpp first tokens at 60, 108, 157 and 200 s; this port all four at 140 to 142 s by default, or 36, 72, 108 and 145 s with --prefill-srpt. Mean KL from a full-precision run of the same checkpoint: this port 0.0011, llama.cpp Q8_0 0.0013, llama.cpp Q4_K_M 0.0088. Sources: WHY-NOT-LOW-BIT.md and BENCHMARKS-SM70.md.
